result.question: Qual a média móvel de 3 anos de internações no estado do RS por ano (2008-2023)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ano, total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS media_movel_3anos FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE mu."SG_UF" = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY ano) sub ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_ano AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE mu."SG_UF" = 'RS' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") ), media_movel AS ( SELECT ano, total_internacoes, AVG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS media_movel_3_anos FROM internacoes_por_ano ) SELECT ano, media_movel_3_anos FROM media_movel ORDER BY ano;
